name: Semi-Circle Banner
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Made from premium 15oz blockout scrim vinyl, this semi-circular banner is durable, weather-resistant, and designed to block light and prevent shadows or show-through.
    - The matte surface reduces glare and provides a professional display appearance for both indoor and outdoor use.
    - Includes 3 brass grommets along the diameter for easy hanging.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Available in multiple sizes:
    36 x 18 in ~ 91.44 x 45.72 cm
    72 x 36 in ~ 182.88 x 91.44 cm
    📌 Note: The semi-circular shape is fixed and cannot be changed. Customers may customize only the printed design.

 

  • Printing Technology:
    - Printed using solvent printing technology with matte finish.
    - High-quality solvent printing for vibrant, clear, and sharp images.
    - Single-sided printing with trimmed edges for a clean and professional look.

 

  • Care Instructions:
    - For spot cleaning only, use dish soap with warm water.
    - Use non-abrasive, non-ammonium-based cleaning products.

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - Perfect for parties, celebrations, weddings, birthdays, graduations, baby showers, business promotions, school events, storefront displays, trade shows, and home decorations.
    - Suitable for both indoor and outdoor applications. Comes with white ropes for convenient hanging and display.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - This custom semi-circular banner makes a fun and personalized gift for family, friends, coworkers, students, teachers, and loved ones.
    - Ideal for birthdays, anniversaries, graduations, retirement parties, holiday celebrations, and many other special occasions.

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1-3 working days on average after payment, and all designs are updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x Semi-Circle Banner

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • Tracking Country Origin is US

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 1-3 cm differences due to manual measurement.

Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.
    • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
